Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

sharedimp 0.1.0

Initial release.

  • shared_importance(): UMFI-LR with fold-internal residualization, paired full/reduced out-of-sample evaluation, metric-direction-aware sign, no truncation of negative values, per-fold results, reproducible seed.
  • Regression, binary and multiclass classification; built-in "rand_forest" (ranger) and "linear" learners, any parsnip model specification, or a custom sharedimp_learner().
  • Metrics via yardstick (mse, rmse, mae, rsq, mn_log_loss, accuracy, roc_auc, or any yardstick metric function).
  • Low-level helpers residualize_fit(), residualize_apply(), build_representations().
  • Optional direction = TRUE diagnostic.
  • Shared R/Python specification in docs/specification.md; comparison with the reference implementation in docs/umfi_comparison.md.

Developed by Koki Tsuyuzaki.
